messages.火傷と精神力ダメージを与えつつ、次のターンの味方全体に憤怒ダメージ量増加を配る、: A support-type Wrath E.G.O that inflicts Burn and SP damage while handing Wrath DMG Up to all allies for the next turn.
messages.憤怒ダメージ量増加: 攻撃後、次のターンに味方全体へ憤怒ダメージ量増加1を付与す: **Wrath DMG Up**: After the attack, gives 1 Wrath DMG Up to all allies next turn. It is an after-attack effect, so it does not depend on whether the attack hits.
messages.火傷と精神力ダメージ: 的中時に火傷3(解析Ⅲは4)と、対象への精神力ダメージ7: **Burn and SP damage**: On hit, inflicts 3 Burn (4 at Threadspin Ⅲ) and deals 7 SP damage to the target (15 at Threadspin Ⅲ). Effective against enemies with SP.
messages.喝采の中、息の根を断つ: 攻撃対象の体力が30%未満のとき、憤怒属性スキルのダメ: **Passive — Slaying Amid Cheers**: +20% damage for Wrath skills when the target is below 30% HP.
messages.低コスト: 必要資源は憤怒2・色欲2・怠惰1、精神消耗は覚醒20。: **Low cost**: Requires 2 Wrath, 2 Lust, and 1 Sloth, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 20.
messages.先に撃って、次のターンに憤怒スキルをまとめて使う。バフが次のターンに付くので、ダ: Fire it first, then use Wrath skills together on the next turn. The buff applies next turn, making it easy to time when to deal damage.
messages.火力目的なら紅炎殺(0803)の方が向く。このE.G.Oは場づくりが主役と考えら: For damage, Ardor Blossom Star (0803) is better suited. This E.G.O is likely mainly about setting up the field.
messages.侵蝕スキルは全キャラクターに憤怒脆弱と憤怒ダメージ量増加を付けるため、味方も被害: The Corrosion skill gives every character Wrath Fragility and Wrath DMG Up, so allies also suffer.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、火傷と精神力ダメージが増える。バフ役としての変化は無い。: **Ⅲ**: Raises power, and increases Burn and SP damage. No change in its buffing role.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が2になり広域化する。バフ役としての変化は無く、優先度は低いと考: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 2 for multi-target attacks. No change in its buffing role, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.南部リウ協会4課: 全スキルが火傷を付与し、憤怒のS2も持つので、憤怒ダメージ量: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0806)**: All of her skills inflict Burn, and she has a Wrath S2, making Wrath DMG Up easy to use.
messages.定事務所代表: S1(憤怒)・S2(怠惰)で必要資源の一部を出せる。: **[Jeong's Office Rep](persona:0813)**: S1 (Wrath) and S2 (Sloth) supply some of the required affinities.
